exposure: nuchal cord (single, double, or triple loop)
cohort: Patients presenting at 28-41 weeks gestation who delivered by cesarean or vaginal birth and whose babies had a nuchal cord.
finding: Nuchal cord was a common incidental finding during labor, and fetal outcome (APGAR score and NICU admission) was generally good in babies with a nuchal cord, although the cesarean section rate was higher in this group.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in the presence of nuchal cord.
